title: The top trends in tech (executive summary)
notes: First edition (2025 report calls itself the fifth edition; 2026 the sixth). Published June 2021 as an online interactive ('The top trends in tech') plus an 18-slide executive-summary PDF; the interactive is JavaScript-rendered and was not read. 10 trends: 7 industry-agnostic, 3 industry-specific. No equity-investment, job-posting or adoption figures per trend (momentum score only, in charts). Forecast entries are the dated figures on slide 7 'Effects of technology trends up to 2050'. rank = trend number as printed; forecast entries carry their trend's rank.

entries.label: Next-level process automation and virtualization
entries.quote: Self-learning, reconfigurable robots will drive automation of physical processes beyond routine activities to include less predictable ones
entries.subject: Process automation and virtualization
entries.note: Quote reconstructed from slide columns (pdftotext layout). Underlying technologies listed: Industrial IoT, robots/cobots/RPA, digital twins, 3-D/4-D printing.

entries.label: Next-level process automation and virtualization
entries.quote: 50% of today’s work activities could be automated by 2025
entries.subject: Automation of work activities
entries.metric: share of today's work activities that could be automated
entries.note: Quote reconstructed from slide columns (pdftotext layout). Slide 'Effects of technology trends up to 2050'.

entries.label: Future of connectivity
entries.quote: enhanced coverage and speed of connections across long and short distances will enable new services (eg, remote patient monitoring), business models (eg, connected services), and next-generation customer experiences (eg, live VR)
entries.subject: 5G and IoT connectivity
entries.note: Quote reconstructed from slide columns (pdftotext layout).

entries.label: Future of connectivity

entries.label: Applied AI
entries.quote: As AI matures and continues to scale, it will enable new applications (eg, more rapid development cycles and detailed customer insights)

Slide 7 also states '>75% of all digital-service touch points (eg, voice assistants) will see improved usability, enriched personalization, and increased conversion' with no year (slide title: effects up to 2050); not captured as a forecast.

entries.label: Future of programming
entries.quote: Software 2.0 creates new ways of writing software and reduces complexity
entries.subject: Software 2.0
entries.note: Quote reconstructed from slide columns (pdftotext layout). Slide 7: '~30× reduction in the working time required for software development', no year; not captured as a forecast.

entries.label: Trust architecture
entries.quote: Trust architectures help commercial entities and individuals establish trust and conduct business without need for intermediaries, even as zero-trust-security measures address growing cyberattacks
entries.subject: Zero-trust security and blockchain
entries.note: Quote reconstructed from slide columns (pdftotext layout).

entries.label: Trust architecture
entries.quote: ~10% of global GDP could be associated with blockchain by 2027

entries.label: Bio Revolution
entries.quote: “-omics” enable rapid analysis of genetic materials and open up possibilities (eg, for rapid vaccine development, personalized medicine, and gene therapy)
entries.subject: Biotechnology (omics, biomachines)
entries.note: Quote reconstructed from slide columns (pdftotext layout). Slide 7 past figure: 45× cost reduction for sequencing the human genome in the past 10 years.

entries.label: Next-generation materials
entries.quote: next-generation materials may change industry economics and reconfigure companies within them
entries.subject: Advanced materials (nanomaterials, graphene, 2-D materials)
entries.note: Quote reconstructed from slide columns (pdftotext layout). Slide 7 past figure: 10× growth in number of patents between 2008 and 2018.

entries.label: Future of clean technologies
entries.quote: As clean technologies come down the cost curve, they become increasingly disruptive to traditional business models
entries.subject: Clean energy technologies
entries.note: Quote reconstructed from slide columns (pdftotext layout). Underlying technologies: nuclear fusion, smart distribution/metering, battery storage, carbon-neutral energy generation.
